# Benjamin Koh
benjamin.koh@example.test | +65 6000 0082 | Singapore

## SUMMARY
Junior Business Analyst with a Bachelor of Science in Information Systems and hands-on experience transforming operational needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. Proven ability to gather requirements, map processes, and analyze data to drive evidence-based decisions. Skilled in collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to deliver well-tested improvements while maintaining clear documentation and quality controls.

## EXPERIENCE

**Junior Business Analyst** | Example Beacon Services (Jan 2025 – Present)
*   Gathered and documented business requirements using user stories, improving team turnaround by 28%.
*   Mapped current and future processes in Excel to support technical and business reviewers, ensuring clear documentation of decisions.
*   Analyzed operational data across approximately 96 monthly work items to identify trends and support evidence-based decision-making.
*   Coordinated with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, business) to track quality checks and manage follow-up actions.
*   Communicated progress, risks, and technical trade-offs to stakeholders during fortnightly reviews.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Cedar Innovations (May 2024 – Dec 2024)
*   Supported recurring operational work by writing SQL queries and documenting step-by-step procedures for reproducibility.
*   Investigated service requests, recorded findings with clear supporting evidence, and escalated issues to relevant stakeholders.
*   Designed a reporting template that reduced manual preparation time by 23%, demonstrating ability to deliver useful outcomes.

**Junior Business Analyst Practice Project** | Independent
*   Built a demonstration project utilizing requirements gathering, process mapping, and Excel to simulate real-world scenarios.
*   Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the project with representative scenarios and recording limitations.
*   Presented design and outcomes to a five-person peer review group, honing clear written and verbal communication skills.

## EDUCATION

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example Metropolitan University (Aug 2020 – May 2024)
*   Relevant Coursework: Software Engineering, Databases, Cybersecurity, Applied Analytics.

## SKILLS
*   **Core Competencies:** Requirements Gathering, Process Mapping, Data Analysis, Documentation, User Stories.
*   **Tools & Technologies:** Excel, SQL, Power BI.
*   **Methodologies:** Agile, UAT support.
*   **Soft Skills:** Stakeholder Communication, Collaborative Problem Solving, Clear Written/Verbal Communication.

# Junior Business Analyst



**Company:** Example Meridian Labs (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Entry



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Meridian Labs is seeking a Junior Business Analyst to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Gather and document business requirements.

* Map current and future processes.

* Analyse operational data.

* Support user acceptance testing.

* Coordinate with business and technology teams.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* requirements gathering

* process mapping

* Excel

* SQL

* stakeholder communication

* user stories

* data analysis

* documentation

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Power BI

* Agile

* UAT



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.
